name: Temple Spell Store
desc1: The hall's lofty roof is supported by graceful soaring archways, and
desc2: the walls are crafted of white marble run through with silver streaks.
desc3: A thin monk sits behind a thick oaken table here, and as you enter he
desc4: nods. A large bookshelf to his right holds a great many scrolls, all
desc5: of which are inscribed with holy runes of magic. This is where the
desc6: divinely inspired come to purchase the knowledge which enables them
desc7: to channel the might of their god into practical means.
